transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net TV customer support, my name is Laura. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello Laura. I am an elderly pensioner living alone, and yesterday an engineer came and fitted a new TV 360 box, and now the entire television screen looks completely alien to me! All my recorded episodes of Coronation Street have disappeared, and I cannot figure out how to watch the evening news!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I understand how disorienting and frustrating it is when a software update changes your familiar television layout, Joseph. Let's look into your TV 360 profile right now.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you Laura, because sitting in a quiet house with no television to watch in the evening is very lonely.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Before we access the set-top box settings, could you please verify your installation address and your four-digit security PIN?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, the address is 14 Hawthorn Close, Bolton, BL1 8DE, and the security PIN is 5102. My favorite program Coronation Street on ITV is completely missing from the planner.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for verifying those account details, Joseph. I have your TV 360 box open on our remote diagnostics dashboard.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Great, thanks.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let me examine the firmware configuration and user interface settings on your box.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The old remote control had a big yellow button that took me straight to my recordings, but this new remote has dozens of tiny black buttons that all look the same.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The new TV 360 remote utilizes an icon-based navigation menu with dedicated Home and Profile keys.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: When I press the button with the picture of a house on it, a big dark screen pops up with thirty different colored picture tiles that I don't understand.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The Home screen displays algorithmic personalized recommendations and live broadcast tiles across popular streaming platforms.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The technician also gave me a brand new black HDMI cable and plugged it into HDMI 2 on the back of the television set.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: HDMI Port 2 carries full 1080p high definition digital video signals directly from the set-top box to your television screen.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I don't want algorithmic recommendations! I just want to watch Coronation Street and the six o'clock news on BBC One!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: To access live broadcast channels, you press the Guide button located directly beneath the volume toggle on your handheld remote.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I pressed that Guide button, but the writing across the entire screen is microscopic white letters on a dark navy blue background.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The TV 360 electronic program guide is rendered in ultra-high-definition font scaling.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: My television is an older thirty-two inch set in the corner of the room, so the tiny print is just a blurry illegible smudge.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Please bear with me on hold for about thirty-five seconds while I query the accessibility profile on your set-top box.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, Joseph. The remote software telemetry indicates your box is currently running default display resolution settings.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The letters on the TV screen are so small and faint I can barely read the channel numbers even with my reading bifocals on!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Well Mr. Joseph, if you can't read standard television menus with your glasses on, maybe you need an updated prescription from your optician rather than blaming the TV box.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: There is no need to be cheeky and patronizing to an old man, young lady! My eyes are tested every year, and the old S-Net box was perfectly legible!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I apologize if my remark sounded sharp, Joseph. I was merely pointing out that display scaling depends on your eyesight and panel size.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I am asking how to make the guide letters bigger so I can read what is on television.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You will need to have a family member or a younger neighbor come round to your house and read through the on-screen settings menu for you.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: My daughter lives in Australia and my neighbors are at work all day! Why can't S-Net customer service help an elderly customer adjust the settings over the phone?!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: We do not provide in-home remote control tutoring or personalized visual calibration over telephone support lines.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is a dreadful attitude towards elderly customers who pay thirty pounds every month!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can push an automated firmware accessibility configuration profile to your box from my terminal.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What does that accessibility profile do to the screen?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It activates High Contrast Large Text mode, which increases font size by sixty percent across the electronic program guide and switches the background palette to bold high-contrast black and yellow for maximum legibility.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: High-contrast black and yellow will be much easier on my tired eyes.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am pushing the accessibility profile update now... your TV box will refresh its screen within ten seconds.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Looking at the television... the guide just flashed... goodness me, the channel numbers are three times bigger now! I can read BBC One and ITV without squinting!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That confirms the high-contrast accessibility scaling has initialized successfully.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is a wonderful improvement, thank you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Now let us locate your missing broadcast episodes on the catch-up service.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, I missed Monday's episode while the engineer was disconnecting the old cables.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Press the microphone voice button on the center of your remote control, hold it down, and say the name of the show clearly.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Holding the microphone button down... speaking into the remote: 'Coronation Street'...

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The voice search will scan the ITVX catch-up on-demand library automatically.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It worked! Monday's episode popped right up in the middle of the screen with a big button saying 'Watch from Start'!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Press the large circular OK button in the center of the arrow keypad to begin playing.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The theme music is playing and the picture is crystal clear! What a relief!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: What specific television program were you trying to locate in your recordings list?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: As I told you right at the start of our call, Coronation Street on ITV!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Right, I have set a permanent Series Link on ITV for Coronation Street, so every new episode will record automatically.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That means I won't have to fiddle with voice search every single evening.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, future broadcast episodes will appear under the Saved section automatically.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: And does the voice button work for the evening news as well?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, you can simply hold the voice button and say 'BBC News at Six' to tune in directly.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That voice button makes using the remote so much simpler than reading tiny buttons.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: How is your broadband connection performing alongside the TV service at your property?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The broadband internet has been working fine for my computer, it was purely the new television box that had me flummoxed.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am very pleased to hear your internet service remains stable and reliable.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you for getting the large font and the soap opera working.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The accessibility setup reference number logged on your profile is ACC-88192-J.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Noted down... ACC-88192-J.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have verified that the large font high-contrast accessibility profile is permanently active, your Coronation Street series link is locked on ITVX, and voice search is working clearly on your remote. Does that resolve all your television questions today, Joseph?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes Laura, you've sorted out the big writing and my show is playing. Thank you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net today, Joseph. Enjoy your television program. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you Laura, goodbye.
